AdminAccess.title: Access control
AdminAccess.subtitle: Define roles, choose what each role may open or change in the admin panel, and assign people to them. Full-access admins are never limited.

howItWorks.title: How access works
howItWorks.full: Super admins, and admins you have not limited, can open and change everything.
howItWorks.limited: A limited admin can only use the areas their roles grant: View lets them open and read, Manage also lets them change.
howItWorks.newPages: New admin pages are blocked for limited admins until you grant them here.

roles.title: Roles
roles.empty: No custom roles yet. Create one, then choose its permissions.

role.deleteBody: Everyone holding it loses these permissions. People stay under access management with no access until you give them another role.

matrix.title: Permissions
matrix.help: Pick the highest level each area needs. Manage includes View.
matrix.sensitiveHint: Moves money or exposes personal data
matrix.unlistedHint: A page that exists but has no menu entry yet
matrix.pendingHint: This area's server-side checks are not connected to roles yet, so it cannot be granted
matrix.unlimitedOnlyHint: Cannot be granted to a custom role
matrix.stale: {count, plural, one {# saved permission refers to an area that no longer exists and will be removed on save.} other {# saved permissions refer to areas that no longer exist and will be removed on save.}}
matrix.summary: {count, plural, one {# area granted} other {# areas granted}}

members.title: Members
members.help: Search for a person to give this role. They are made an admin (needed by the backend) and limited to their roles.

staff.title: Limited admins
staff.help: People whose access is managed here. A limited admin with no role has no access.
staff.fullHelp: These admins are not limited. Limit one to put them under the roles above; until you give them a role they will have no access.
staff.fullEmpty: No unlimited admins other than super admins.
staff.confirmLimit: Limit {name}? They will have no access until you give them a role.

denied.title: You don't have access to this page
denied.body: Your roles do not include this area. Ask a full-access admin to grant it.
denied.none: You have no admin access right now. If you expected some, ask a full-access admin.
denied.unavailable: Access could not be checked. Please retry shortly.

errors.unauthorized: Only full-access admins can manage access.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with an existing item.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was changed.
